## Engagement strategy

Group each stakeholder by quadrant of the influence × interest grid.

### Manage Closely — high influence, high interest

_[List stakeholders. These parties require active engagement, frequent updates, and direct involvement in key decisions.]_

### Keep Satisfied — high influence, low interest

_[List stakeholders. Keep these parties informed of major decisions and risks; do not flood them with operational detail.]_

### Keep Informed — low influence, high interest

_[List stakeholders. Provide regular progress updates; their interest means they will notice gaps in communication.]_

### Monitor — low influence, low interest

_[List stakeholders. Maintain awareness; escalate to a higher quadrant if their influence or interest changes.]_
